thread:
acme-sre: customer reports spikes in p95. They say some traffic is going to eu and adding ~300ms. They use our JS SDK and set region in config.

maria: can you share a sample header dump and a request id so we can pull edge logs?

acme-sre: org=acme-corp, req id r-7f8e9d0a
Sample curl reproducer:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -H "X-Client-Region: " \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```
SDK trims region into header as empty string when unset.

maria: looked at edge entries for r-7f8e9d0a:
```
[edge] incoming X-Client-Region=""
[routing] header present -> validate
[routing] invalid -> apply tenant-region-priority [eu,us]
[routing] routed to eu-west-2
```

kenji: brief routing rules: absent header = geo routing. header present = explicit, validated. Empty string currently counts as present & invalid -> fallback. historical behavior; not great.

acme-sre: So client sending empty header causes worse result vs omitting it.

maria: mitigation ideas:
1) Ask SDK team to not emit header when empty (longer-term)
2) Edge/CDN change: treat empty as absent (short-term)
3) Return 400 for invalid region values (longer-term, needs API contract)

julian: I'll implement CDN rule to drop X-Client-Region when value=="" and follow with ingress change to treat trimmed-empty as missing. Plan: CDN rule in 30m, canary ingress in us-east in 3h.

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1991 "empty X-Client-Region -> EU fallback" assigned to julian

acme-sre: customer wants quick patch. Also found SDK snippet: `headers['X-Client-Region'] = opts.region || ''` -> change to `if (opts.region) headers['X-Client-Region']=opts.region`.

maria: tagging @julian @kenji for rollout and follow-up. Please paste canary logs and updated request ids here after deployment. :thumbsup:

julian: on it. will post canary metrics and rollback criteria. reporting back in this thread.
